newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products seen slightly stronger with soy.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products seen slightly stronger with soy.

text.p: CBOT soymeal and soyoil futures were called to open slightly higher Friday, boosted by expected gains in soybean futures, traders said.
Soymeal futures were expected to open $0.50 to $1.00 per ton higher, with soyoil seen up 0.05 to 0.10 cent a lb.
Soybeans are expected to open higher on forecasts for wet and cool weather next week in the U.S. Midwest.
Many traders said that trade could be extremely quiet ahead of USDA's supply and demand report due Monday.
